description: This file contains unit tests for SQL Server storage implementation in an Orleans-based project. It defines a test class with multiple test methods to verify persistence, data integrity, and error handling for relational storage using ADO.NET with SQL Server.

classes.name: SqlServerStorageTests
classes.description: A test class for SQL Server storage in Orleans, inheriting from RelationalStorageTests, with multiple test methods for persistence and data integrity.

methods.name: WriteReadCyrillic
methods.description: Tests writing and reading Cyrillic characters to ensure proper encoding and decoding.

methods.name: WriteReadWriteRead100StatesInParallel
methods.description: Tests concurrent read/write operations on 100 states to verify thread safety and performance.

methods.name: StorageDataSetGeneric_HashCollisionTests
methods.description: Tests for hash collision scenarios in data sets.

methods.name: WriteDuplicateFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Verifies that duplicate writes fail with the appropriate exception.

methods.name: WriteInconsistentFailsWithIncosistentStateException
methods.description: Verifies that inconsistent state writes fail with the appropriate exception.

methods.name: Store_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Generic method to test storing, clearing, and reading data sets with various key types.

methods.name: GetTestData
methods.description: Static method to generate test data for different key types and data sets.

methods.name: Relational_Json_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization/deserialization during storage operations.

methods.name: Relational_Binary_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests binary serialization/deserialization during storage operations.
